library(XLConnect)
# library(readxl)
# library(xlsx)

        }

    else upper <- as.numeric(input$DIS.upper)

    apply(DIS.index.panel(), 2, gm_mean, na.rm=T)
  })

    infile <-  Infile()[[3]]

        }
        else(data[i, j] <- as.numeric(data.raw[i, j]))
      }
    }
    colnames(data) <- panelist

      upper <- 9

      target <- 1
    else  target <-  as.numeric(input$REP.target)
    d <- (upper-data)/(upper-target)
    d[data>upper] <- 0  # not preferred
    d[data<target] <- 1  # most preferred
    d

  })

    infile <-  Infile()[[4]]

    for(i in 1:nrow(data)){
      for(j in 1:ncol(data)){
        if(is.na(as.numeric(data.raw[i, j]))){
          if( length(grep("<", data.raw[i, j]))==1 ) data[i, j] <- as.numeric(sub("<", "", data.raw[1, 2]))/2
          else data[i, j] <- NA
        }
        else(data[i, j] <- as.numeric(data.raw[i, j]))
      }
    }
    colnames(data) <- panelist
    rownames(data) <- attribute
    # discrimination index; lower is better
    if(is.na(as.numeric(input$AGR.target)))
      target <- 0.95
    else target <- as.numeric(input$AGR.target)
    if(is.na(as.numeric(input$AGR.lower)))
      lower <- 0.5
    else  lower <-  as.numeric(input$AGR.lower)
    d <- (data-lower)/(target-lower)
    d[data>target] <- 1  # most preferred
    d[data<lower] <- 0  # not preferred
    d
  })

    apply(AGR.index.panel(), 2, gm_mean, na.rm=T)
  })
  
  final.index <- reactive({
    exp( (4*log(DIS.index()) + 3*log(REP.index()) + 3*log(AGR.index())) / 10 )
    
  })
  
  output$contents <- renderTable({
    # input$file1 will be NULL initially. After the user selects
    # and uploads a file, it will be a data frame with 'name',
    # 'size', 'type', and 'datapath' columns. The 'datapath'
    # column will contain the local filenames where the data can
    # be found.
    if(is.null(input$data.file))
      return(NULL)
    data.frame(DIS=DIS.index(), REP=REP.index(), AGR=AGR.index(), FINAL=final.index())
    
  }, include.rownames=TRUE)

    content = function(file) {

      # write.xlsx(REP.index.panel(),file, sheetName="REP desirability",append=TRUE)
      # write.xlsx(AGR.index.panel(),file, sheetName="AGR desirability",append=TRUE)
      # write.xlsx(final,file, sheetName="Summary",append=TRUE)
      
    }
    
  )

    clr<-"#336699"
    if(is.null(input$data.file)){
      par(bg="white",col.lab=clr)
      plot(0,xaxt='n',yaxt='n',bty='n',pch='',ylab='',xlab='')
      return(NULL)}
    x<-rev(final.index())
    par(bg="white",col.lab=clr,mar = c(3.1,10,1.6,2),las=2,cex=1)
    infile <-  Infile()[[4]]

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
